name: Stamina and Combat Tricks — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Stamina and Combat Tricks from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Stamina and Combat Tricks Optional Rules" but are not part of the Stamina and Combat Tricks entry, which is unchanged.

New Feats

The following feats are used with the stamina and combat tricks system. The basic feat is Combat Stamina, which grants you a stamina pool and allows you to use the most basic combat trick for this system. The other feats give you options for expanding your stamina pool.

Combat Stamina (Combat)

You stop at nothing to drive your attack home.

Prerequisite(s): Base attack bonus +1.

Combat Tricks

Nearly every combat feat has a combat trick associated with it. Some very basic feats, such as weapon and proficiency feats, do not; nor do feats that expand upon the stamina and combat tricks system.
